name: Tsukishima Otoha
source: The first and oldest daughter of the Tsukishima family. Like her other sisters Otoha is a teacher and she takes care of the household in general too, just like a housewife.
translation: The first and oldest daughter of the Tsukishima family. Like her other sisters Otoha is a teacher and she takes care of the household in general too, just like a housewife.
